personas.name: advanced_uniform
personas.description: Confidently correct across a wide spread of topics — an advanced student.

known_limitations.explanation: The per-concept evidence term is a flat correct/total average with no recency weighting. This persona is 3 correct then 4 incorrect (43% overall) -- a clear recent decline the flat average doesn't reflect. See TESTING.md and RESEARCH_ADVANCEMENTS.md Sec 4.1 (Core Contribution 1).

With only ~10-12 online gradient steps taken, the model hasn't moved far enough from its shared content-grounded initialization to differentiate an advanced-history student from a beginner-history student on a topic NEITHER has touched. Expected to improve as real usage accumulates more online-adaptation steps. See TESTING.md.
